en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 2. Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (RA) said: Sa`d ibn `Abd Allah said, on the authority of Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn `Isa, on the authority of al-Husayn ibn Sa`id, on the authority of alNadr ibn Suwayd, on the authority of `Asim Humayd that `Ali ibn al-Husayn (AS) was asked about Divine Unity; hence, he said
Verily, Allah, the Mighty and High, knew that there would be people in the Last Days who would think deeply;

therefore, Allah, the Mighty and High, revealed: Say: He Allah is One. Allah is the Needless and the first few verses from the surah “the Iron” until He says: And He is Cognizant of what is in the hearts.
Thus whosoever goes beyond that is ruined.
